Nvidia keeps 56 cents of every dollar as profit.
Fiscal 2026 (ended Jan 2026): $215.9 billion in revenue, $120.1 billion in net income.
About 90% of revenue ($193.7B) came from data centers: AI chips plus networking.
Revenue was $10.92 billion in fiscal 2020. In the quarter ended July 2026, gross margin was 75%.
Sources: Nvidia 10-K and earnings releases.
